hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Outlet header
function: The header collecting the runs downstream of the chokes and leading to the separator.

tabs.overview: Downstream pressure is separator pressure plus line loss; still rated with the manifold because a stuck choke can pass full pressure.
tabs.safety: Downstream iron is not low pressure until the separator relief is proven.
